clips.title: The story
paras: Along North Tide's Run, the Minor Manifestation of Water awaits shamans on Silverpine Forest's coast. Its corrupted counterpart must be cleansed before the peaceful spirit can be consulted.

The Minor Manifestation of Water waits west of the Sepulcher, along North Tide's Run. For developing shamans, meeting the spirit is an essential rite. Water elementals embody life, renewal, and fluidity, yet malevolent blight can corrupt them. An initiate must face and defeat a corrupted manifestation before the pure spirit reveals itself. Once cleansed, the Minor Manifestation of Water guides shamans on their sacred journey to fashion a Water Totem.
